PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for commafeed. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Require owner authentication for every application route.

QUARKUS_HTTP_HOST.description: Quarkus http host for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

QUARKUS_HTTP_PORT.description: Quarkus http port for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

QUARKUS_DATASOURCE_JDBC_URL.description: Quarkus datasource jdbc url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

QUARKUS_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD.description: Quarkus datasource password resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

QUARKUS_DATASOURCE_USERNAME.description: Quarkus datasource username for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

COMMAFEED_USERS_ALLOW_REGISTRATIONS.description: Commafeed users allow registrations for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

COMMAFEED_USERS_CREATE_DEMO_ACCOUNT.description: Commafeed users create demo account for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

COMMAFEED_USERS_MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH.description: Commafeed users minimum password length for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

QUARKUS_HTTP_AUTH_SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated quarkus http auth session encryption key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.
